rules.statement: A Dataset must carry a stable identifier and a human-readable name.
A Dataset must identify the Source System that owns it. Ownership is singular and unambiguous.
A Dataset must describe its Fields such that, for each Field, a consumer can determine whether it is a Dimension or a Measure. Every Field carries a unique key, a label, and a role.
Every Measure must declare which aggregations are meaningful for it. Declaring an aggregation asserts that its result carries meaning, not merely that it computes.
Every Field must state explicitly whether it may be used to filter records and whether it may be used to order them. Omission is not a default — it is an undeclared Field.
A Dataset must carry a data classification indicating the sensitivity of the data it exposes.
A Dataset must state explicitly whether it exposes personal data. This drives the access recording obligation in FR-DA-14, so it cannot be left to inference.

A Dataset must declare its row grain: the Fields whose combination identifies one row, or an empty list where the endpoint answers with a single summary row. An Author choosing a Dataset cannot otherwise tell a one-row summary from two thousand records, and the two feed almost disjoint sets of Visualization Types.

Every Filter Parameter must state whether it is required, and must declare its accepted values wherever those are enumerable. A parameter whose values are not declared renders as an empty control: the Viewer is offered a filter with nothing to pick.

dataShape.summary: One or more Dimensions and/or Measures

visualizationTypes.name: Data table
visualizationTypes.description: Sortable and filterable rows with pagination, column configuration (visibility, width, pinning), row selection and expandable rows.

visualizationTypes.name: Pivot table
visualizationTypes.description: Grouped rows and columns with aggregation.

visualizationTypes.name: Comparison table
visualizationTypes.description: Side-by-side entities across fixed metrics.

families.name: Trend
families.question: How has this changed over time?

dataShape.summary: One Time Dimension + one or more Measures

visualizationTypes.name: Line chart
visualizationTypes.description: Values joined over time.

visualizationTypes.name: Area chart
visualizationTypes.description: Line chart with the area beneath filled.

visualizationTypes.name: Spline chart
visualizationTypes.description: Curve-smoothed line over time.

visualizationTypes.name: Step chart
visualizationTypes.description: Discrete level changes over time.

dataShape.summary: One Dimension + one or more Measures

visualizationTypes.name: Bar chart (vertical)
visualizationTypes.description: One bar per category, measured on the vertical axis.

visualizationTypes.name: Bar chart (horizontal)
visualizationTypes.description: One bar per category, measured on the horizontal axis. Suits long category labels.

visualizationTypes.name: Grouped bar chart
visualizationTypes.description: Several Measures shown side by side within each category.

visualizationTypes.name: Stacked bar chart
visualizationTypes.description: Several Measures stacked within each category.

families.name: Composition
families.question: What are the parts of this whole?

dataShape.summary: One Dimension + one Measure summing to a meaningful total

clauses.describe: a Measure that sums to a meaningful total

undecidable.requirement: §4.2 requires a Measure "summing to a meaningful total". Additivity is a property of meaning, not of type — FR-DP-04 declares which aggregations are meaningful, but not whether the resulting total is itself meaningful as a whole.
undecidable.resolvedBy: Field semantic 'additive-total', published 17 September. A publisher declares it on the Measure whose total means something.

visualizationTypes.name: Pie chart
visualizationTypes.description: Shares of a whole as circular segments.

visualizationTypes.name: Donut chart
visualizationTypes.description: Pie chart with a hollow centre, often carrying the total.

visualizationTypes.name: Stacked 100% bar
visualizationTypes.description: Shares of a whole as proportions of a full-width bar.

visualizationTypes.name: Treemap
visualizationTypes.description: Shares of a whole as nested rectangles sized by value.

undecidable.requirement: §4.2 requires the Measure be spread "across many records". Record volume is not part of the published model.
undecidable.resolvedBy: Dataset `record_volume`, published 18 September as an order of magnitude — `thousands` or `millions` is the many this clause asks for.

visualizationTypes.name: Histogram
visualizationTypes.description: Record counts bucketed by value range.

visualizationTypes.name: Box plot
visualizationTypes.description: Quartiles, median and outliers.

visualizationTypes.name: Violin plot
visualizationTypes.description: Density of values across the range.

visualizationTypes.name: Scatter plot
visualizationTypes.description: One point per record against two Measures.

visualizationTypes.name: Bubble chart
visualizationTypes.description: Scatter plot with a third Measure encoded as point size.

visualizationTypes.name: Heatmap matrix
visualizationTypes.description: Pairwise Measure relationships encoded as colour intensity.

families.name: Ranking & Flow
families.question: What is the order, or where is the drop-off?

dataShape.summary: One Dimension + one Measure, or ordered stage data

clauses.describe: one Dimension and one Measure, or a Dimension declared as an ordered stage

undecidable.requirement: §4.2 admits "ordered stage data" as an alternative shape. Stage ordering is not expressible in the published model, so the funnel/sankey route cannot be evaluated.
undecidable.resolvedBy: Field semantic 'stage', published 17 September. Declared on the Dimension whose order is what a funnel reads.

visualizationTypes.name: Top-N / ranked list
visualizationTypes.description: Categories ordered by a Measure, truncated to the top N.

visualizationTypes.name: Leaderboard
visualizationTypes.description: Rank, score and movement indicator against the previous period.

visualizationTypes.name: Funnel
visualizationTypes.description: Drop-off across sequential stages.

visualizationTypes.name: Sankey
visualizationTypes.description: Flow volume between stages or categories.

visualizationTypes.name: Bar chart race
visualizationTypes.description: Ranking animated across time periods.

clauses.describe: a Field naming a place, or a latitude and longitude pair

undecidable.requirement: §4.2 requires a "location-typed Dimension". `FieldType` does carry `location`, and a Dataset reports `has_location_field` — but a choropleth shades *named areas* and `location` does not separate a region from a postcode or a street address, which cannot be shaded. Nor can it say that two Measures are a coordinate pair rather than two figures. The type is nearly enough here and not quite: it is the one Family where the published model already reaches for the fact and stops one step short of it.
undecidable.resolvedBy: Field semantics 'geographic-area', or 'geographic-latitude' with 'geographic-longitude', published 17 September. Both halves of the pair are needed; one alone plots nothing.

visualizationTypes.name: Choropleth map
visualizationTypes.description: Regions shaded by a Measure.

visualizationTypes.name: Point / pin map
visualizationTypes.description: Individual locations plotted as points.

families.name: Radial
families.question: How does this compare against a target or across axes?

dataShape.summary: One or more Measures, optionally with a target

visualizationTypes.name: Radar / spider chart
visualizationTypes.description: Several Measures on radial axes from a shared centre.

visualizationTypes.name: Gauge / speedometer
visualizationTypes.description: A single Measure against a range, usually with a target.

families.name: Single Value
families.question: What is the number right now?

dataShape.summary: One Measure, optionally one Time Dimension for trend or comparison

visualizationTypes.name: Stat card
visualizationTypes.description: Large number with a label and a trend arrow or percentage.

visualizationTypes.name: Sparkline card
visualizationTypes.description: Stat card with an embedded mini line or bar chart. Needs a Time Dimension for the spark.

visualizationTypes.name: Progress / goal tracker
visualizationTypes.description: Value against a target, as a bar or a ring.

visualizationTypes.name: Delta card
visualizationTypes.description: Current period against the previous one. Needs a Time Dimension.

families.name: Temporal Pattern
families.question: What is the pattern across time periods or cohorts?

visualizationTypes.name: Calendar heatmap
visualizationTypes.description: Contribution-grid style: one cell per day, shaded by a Measure.

visualizationTypes.name: Cohort / retention grid
visualizationTypes.description: Cohorts down, elapsed periods across.

visualizationTypes.name: Gantt / timeline chart
visualizationTypes.description: Spans positioned and sized along a time axis.

visualizationTypes.name: Activity feed / timeline
visualizationTypes.description: Chronological events, most recent first.

visualizationTypes.name: Log / event viewer
visualizationTypes.description: Raw or structured event stream.

dataShape.summary: One Measure with a threshold, or one state Dimension

clauses.describe: one Measure, or a Dimension declared as a state

undecidable.requirement: §4.2 admits "one state Dimension" as an alternative shape. The published model cannot distinguish a state Dimension from any other Dimension.
undecidable.resolvedBy: Field semantic 'state', published 17 September. Declared on the Dimension holding the condition — settled, pending, failed.

visualizationTypes.name: Status badge / indicator
visualizationTypes.description: Health, uptime or pass/fail state.

visualizationTypes.name: Threshold indicator
visualizationTypes.description: Traffic-light presentation of a Measure against configured thresholds.

visualizationTypes.name: Alert / notification banner
visualizationTypes.description: Prominent banner when a state warrants attention. Display only — Analytics does not alert (§10).
